title: AC1021 ODA maintenance-55 HEADER suffix diagnostic admission

authority.source: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.scope: Specifies R2007 HEADER body/string/handle separation, envelope CRC and sentinels. The post-trailer bytes remain unidentified and are not described as valid padding or semantic data.

physicalWitness.input: ODA 27.1 audit-disabled same-version resave of local untracked AC1021 tablet drawing; see p6-ac1021-oda-crc-table-and-remainders-2026-11-03.json
physicalWitness.independentBitwiseCrc: 0x4EAE using seed 0xC0C1 and reflected polynomial 0xA001 over bytes [16,815)

change: Extend existing unclaimed-suffix envelope admission to AC1021 app-maintenance exactly 55, canonical size only. A nonempty suffix remains gated by matching HEADER CRC and both sentinels. The shared HEADER parser forks body and handle buffers bounded by payloadEnd, publishes a HeaderSectionUnclaimedData warning, and strict conversion refuses incomplete read disposition. Other maintenance versions and high-size-word alternatives remain gated.

validation.focused: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dwg_reader_matrix_tests dwg2dxf -j4; ctest --test-dir build-gcc -R ^libdxfrw_dwg_header_version_envelopes$ --output-on-failure
controls: An authored 739-byte opaque suffix is diagnosed with exact offset and length and leaves source bytes unchanged.
Other maintenance versions 54 and 56 refuse the suffix.
Invalid CRC, begin sentinel, end sentinel, and truncated trailer refuse and clear state.
A CRC-resealed maximum body bit-length cannot borrow bytes from the suffix.

physicalCli.readObservation: operationSucceeded=true; 6473/6473 observed frames published; zero entity/object parse failures and zero R2007 data/system page CRC mismatch reports; one HeaderSectionUnclaimedData warning, offset and expected 833, observed 1572.
physicalCli.export: Strict CLI exits 1 at completeness preflight and preserves the pre-existing destination sentinel.

limits: This is diagnostic read admission, not proof of suffix framing, semantics, discardability, complete graph output or external consumer behavior.
It is one ODA back-save of a local drawing, not a native AutoCAD producer profile.
No DWG/DXF fixture was added or support claim promoted.
